_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); revenue, margin, expense and receivables signals with Google's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'Google is a global technology leader focused on improving the ways people connect with information.' 'We generate our revenue almost entirely from advertising, and the reduction in spending by or loss of advertisers could seriously harm our business.' 'We face significant competition from Microsoft and Yahoo.' 'As our growth rate has slowed, the cyclicality and seasonality in our business has become more pronounced and caused our operating results to fluctuate.' 'In addition, the current general economic downturn may result in fewer commercial queries by our users and may cause advertisers to reduce the amount they spend on online advertising, which could negatively affect the growth rate of our revenues.' (FY2008 10-K); CYCLICAL: the 10-K says so of its own business ('the cyclicality and seasonality in our business'), the BKR, CAT and NVDA reading, not an industry's words; no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a search and advertising company on these dates (OFFSHORE is scoped to IT services), so the watch list is empty; the competitors named are a competitive field, not a theme, and stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS -8.9%/yr (worst year FY01-FY08, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -1.1%/yr (Q1 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 4.8-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +129.2%/yr (FY01-FY08 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +249.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY01-FY08, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: GOOG (retrospective, 2009-05-29) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.04x (26.6% downside to Bear $306.09 / +724.9% upside to Bull $3441.54) | Adj composite 2.50 vs market 1.05: gap +1.45 [UNDERVALUED] | -5% above the EPP floor $439.23 (33x FY09E $13.31) | Conservative 2-yr case: +24.4% total (+12.2%/yr) | At 31.3x FY09E the 15% hurdle price $551.79 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; revenue +6.2% YoY in Q1 2009, forward revenues +6.2% (Q1 2009 revenue growth (no Q2 2009 guide)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
